decisions.reason: As a generic support web service with limited differentiation and no later visible web presence, its standalone option value likely no longer justifies keeping it on the market.
This adjacent database product extends the firm's core data capabilities into a nearby energy market, so an expanding firm would likely keep the option alive despite some uncertainty.
The service is close to the firm's regulatory-calculation core and fits its SaaS and process-platform direction, making it relatively attractive to retain.
A tariff database line with several models is strongly aligned with the firm's market-data and platform strategy, so management would usually continue it unless performance were clearly poor.
Custom web services fit the firm's software, integration, and outsourced-process strengths and can still generate follow-on client value at manageable carrying cost.
Postal-code lookup is another generic utility offering with weak strategic distinctiveness, so it is likely to be withdrawn or folded into broader solutions rather than kept as a separate product.
